answers.question: Is this week's plan a step up from what I've actually been doing?
answers.text:
Comparing this week's plan to what you've actually been doing, it is not a step up — in fact, the planned jogging volume is lower than your recent average. The plan calls for 288 min of jogging across the week, while your mean actual jogging per week over the recent complete weeks before was 318.2 min. So the plan actually steps down from your usual jogging load.

 The week itself starts with 72 minutes of easy jogging on Monday, August 31, followed by Full-body strength (strength) on Tuesday, September 1, 72 minutes of easy jogging on Wednesday, September 2, Upper-body strength (strength) on Thursday, September 3, 72 minutes of easy jogging on Friday, September 4, 72 minutes of easy jogging on Saturday, September 5, and Rest day on Sunday, September 6 — so it mixes jogging days with strength days and a rest day. On Mon Aug 31, your actual workout was a strength session of 50 minutes with a max heart rate of 124 bpm, whereas the plan had 72 minutes of easy jogging — so the plan’s jogging focus differs from what you did that day. Overall, this week’s plan is a lighter jogging week than your recent pattern, not a step up.

answers.question: What does my plan look like over the next few months?
answers.text:
Your long-term plan runs from Monday, August 31 through Sunday, November 22, spanning 12 weeks in 6 phases. You are currently in week 1 of the Base phase, which runs from Monday, August 31 to Sunday, September 13; the next phase begins Monday, September 14. The written plan currently covers 1 week, from Monday, August 31 to Sunday, September 6. The plan's starting point is your recent running volume, which averaged 318.2 minutes per week over the recent weeks, and this is the basis for a step-up comparison.

The phases:

Base: Monday, August 31 to Sunday, September 13 (2 weeks).
Build: Monday, September 14 to Sunday, October 4 (3 weeks). Advance the strength and running workloads gradually while protecting recovery.
Recovery: Monday, October 5 to Sunday, October 11 (1 week). Use a lighter stretch to absorb the latest training block and come back fresher.
Build: Monday, October 12 to Sunday, November 1 (3 weeks). Return to building with restored energy and keep the strength and running balance moving forward.
Recovery: Monday, November 2 to Sunday, November 8 (1 week). Recover briefly to clear fatigue and set up the closing weeks of the plan.
Maintain: Monday, November 9 to Sunday, November 22 (2 weeks). Maintain the muscle and running fitness you have built with steady, repeatable sessions.

And the week-by-week key sessions:

Week 1, starting Monday, August 31 (Base): key session Strength (strength).
Week 2, starting Monday, September 7 (Base): key session Easy (run). Build consistency in the combined strength and running routine so each system adapts without overwhelming the other.
Week 3, starting Monday, September 14 (Build): key session Strength (strength). Advance the strength and running workloads gradually while protecting recovery.
Week 4, starting Monday, September 21 (Build): key session Long (run). Deepen the lifting stimulus and running durability to drive muscle gain and keep aerobic fitness steady.
Week 5, starting Monday, September 28 (Build): key session Strength (strength). Continue blending progressive strength work with running sessions to maintain a strong, hardy frame.
Week 6, starting Monday, October 5 (Recovery): key session Easy (run). Use a lighter stretch to absorb the latest training block and come back fresher.
Week 7, starting Monday, October 12 (Build): key session Tempo (run). Return to building with restored energy and keep the strength and running balance moving forward.
Week 8, starting Monday, October 19 (Build): key session Strength (strength). Push muscular endurance and running resilience further with varied sessions.
Week 9, starting Monday, October 26 (Build): key session Run/walk (run). Consolidate the gains from recent weeks before the final recovery and maintenance block.
Week 10, starting Monday, November 2 (Recovery): key session Easy (run). Recover briefly to clear fatigue and set up the closing weeks of the plan.
Week 11, starting Monday, November 9 (Maintain): key session Strength (strength). Maintain the muscle and running fitness you have built with steady, repeatable sessions.
Week 12, starting Monday, November 16 (Maintain): key session Easy (run). Hold the hard-earned strength and running capacity stable as this block ends.
